s.note: the one he keeps under his hat
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread right to the edges. Spread 4 with coarse-cut Seville orange marmalade and close. Leave the crusts on, cut into squares and wrap each in baking paper. Keep one under your hat for emergencies.

s.note: cake and cocoa at the antique shop
s.how: Beat 150g butter and 150g brown sugar, add 3 eggs, then fold in 200g flour, 300g mixed dried fruit and orange zest. Spread in a tin, arrange 50g almonds in circles on top and bake at 150C for 2 hours. Cut into small slices.

m.how: Brown 750g lamb mince. Add a diced onion and 2 carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml stock and simmer 40 minutes. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and bake at 200C until golden. Serve with 300g buttered peas.

w.how: Butter 8 slices white bread and spread with marmalade. Layer in a dish. Whisk 4 eggs, 400ml milk, 200ml cream and 60g sugar and pour over. Rest 20 minutes and bake at 170C for 40 minutes.

d.how: Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa and 4 tbsp sugar with a splash of milk into a paste. Add 1L milk and a pinch of salt and heat, whisking, until steaming. Pour into china cups. Have a hard-boiled sweet afterwards.
